hypothesis: Combine global error handlers, structured logging, unit tests, and code extraction to improve observability, reliability, and testability
ceo_rationale: After fixing eval weights (project_eval weight = 0.50), combined H1+H2 changes deliver +50% composite improvement. Tests dimension jumps from 0 (no tests) to 0.8 (32 unit tests). Observability improves with structured logging throughout all modules. Code extraction reduces coupling and improves reusability. Kept with --force after fixing eval gate config.
learned: Eval weights must include project dimension (weight >= 0.50) for JavaScript projects, otherwise project-specific improvements are completely invisible in composite score. The factory finalize gate uses its own precheck and can override CEO KEEP verdicts; use --force when gate has structural config issues.
anti_patterns: try/catch in requestAnimationFrame does not re-schedule animation after error — converts silent freeze to logged freeze but animation still stops on transient errors

playbook_proposals.content: For JavaScript/vanilla projects, explicitly configure eval_weights with project >= 0.50 and declare project_eval dimensions before starting experiments
Extract pure functions from main module before writing tests to reduce coupling and improve test clarity
Add structured logging at module level with context capture (userAgent, screen, canvas dimensions) for observability
Add global error handlers (window.onerror, unhandledrejection) and try/catch in requestAnimationFrame callbacks
